description: This file defines a PHP API endpoint class for validating the uniqueness of a customer name within the OrangeHRM Time module. It includes methods for handling GET requests to check if a customer name can be changed to a new value, considering existing entries.

classes.name: ValidationCustomerNameAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for validating the uniqueness of customer names in the OrangeHRM system as part of the Time module. Implements methods for GET requests to check if a customer name is available for use.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to validate if a customer name can be changed to a new value, optionally considering a customer ID to exclude from the check.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET request parameters, including validation for customerName and optional customerId.
